method.boundary: absolute planned source emission to instrumented output; no key/light/audio sensor
method.hardware: real GPIO/DMA, 195 LEDs; Fading mode; instrumented MIDI output
method.matrix: five repeats of four bulk/fade settings; rotate order by one each repeat
method.observer_control: one additional run per setting without the monitor
method.isolated: one 300-second run with bulk enabled, 8 ms fade, monitor enabled
method.main_thread_cpu: external psutil sample every second on CPU 3; weighted mean of intervals entirely within source emission
method.process_cpu: mean of benchmark CPU percentage samples during source emission
method.timings: whole-run diagnostic averages after warm-up reset; includes post-source drain
method.stalls: monitor includes startup and warm-up; bounded latest 1024 records and total counts

publication.raw_logs: retained locally; not published because they contain device/port identities
publication.data: all per-run timing summaries, CPU samples, counts, hashes and retained GC records
publication.stall_records_archive: pipeline_8bb30e7_stalls.json.gz; all retained canary records by run name

report.latency_origin: absolute planned emission; includes source scheduling lateness

pipeline.latency_sample_scope: latest events; counts and hashes cover the complete run
